economic_hypothesis: When broad participation remains bearish but improves over five completed sessions, a small daily basket of individually oversold active-demand ignitions captures early risk-transfer without treating a market-wide rebound as hundreds of independent opportunities.
admission: exact causal all-market BEAR state at completed signal close
all-market positive completed-20-session-return share is strictly greater than five completed market sessions earlier

translation.entry: first legal executable open strictly after completed signal, no later than three market sessions

portfolio.same_date_rank: higher completed signal step return, then event_id

daily_cap_selection_rationale: smallest predeclared cap among 5, 10 and 20 new entries per sleeve per day that retained more than fifty capacity-accepted trades per year on average; not selected by return

historical_status.2022_2023: positive each year but post-observation, not pristine OOS

known_limitations: 2022-2023 component outcomes were observed during research
a genuinely new future challenge is required before deployment
